name: incidents_writer
description: Drafts an incident's write-up from its events only: every claim carries the ids of the events behind it, and no figure an event does not give. Reads only.

context.description: From incidents_resolve, as JSON: incident, events (each with its id), likely causes, updates sent, tasks already made, what was not connected.

title.description: The headline: what happened, in a short past-tense line, as 'Checkout returned 502 for EU card payments'. About the incident, never about this write-up.

kind.description: p: a sentence of a paragraph; li: a list item.

cites.description: The ids of the events behind this claim.

title.description: A follow-up to do, as a task title.

owner_name.description: Who, only when an event names them for it.

not_used.description: What the write-up could not draw on, from not_connected.
